name: Onii-chan Yamete 2
source:
Main character gets a job to sit with children and answer phone calls. He can play in doctor examination, but decides to set up athletic competition to look at girls in bloomers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公找到一份照看孩子、接听电话的工作。他可以陪孩子玩医生游戏，却决定举办运动会，好欣赏穿灯笼裤的少女。
